entities.description: A young male soldier of South Asian descent stands facing forward, wearing a full olive-green military uniform, tactical vest, and helmet while holding an assault rifle across his chest. He has a serious expression and is equipped with a utility belt, leg holster, and combat boots, standing on a sandy surface with a barbed-wire fence in the background.

entities.description: A young man with dark hair and a beard stands with his hands clasped in front of him, wearing a beige hooded sweatshirt, blue jeans, and dark sneakers. He has a backpack on and appears to be in a tense situation, flanked by a person in military gear holding a rifle on the left.

A young male soldier with a medium complexion stands facing forward, wearing a full olive-green military uniform including a helmet, tactical vest, and combat boots. He holds a black assault rifle with a curved magazine across his chest with both hands, wearing green tactical gloves, while a knife sheath is attached to his right thigh.

entities.description: A man with dark curly hair and a full beard stands facing forward, wearing a dark navy blue hooded sweatshirt with drawstrings and light blue denim jeans. He has a neutral expression and is wearing brown shoes, standing on a sandy surface next to a person in a military uniform.

A woman with a serious expression stands facing forward, wearing a full-length black abaya and a matching black hijab that covers her hair and neck. She has her hands clasped in front of her waist and is wearing simple flat sandals on her feet.
